8/21

# Camps near Salmvorth. Va -
# Head. quarters Genl. Sturgis. (2<sup>nd</sup>) Division
# Dec. 8<sup>th</sup> 1862. -

# Mrs Brown & Co.

Dear friends -
Mr Wells

returns tomorrow, and I implore the opportunity to send a line by him to you. ~~portently to send~~ a line by him to you. not feeling quite certain if posted matter reaches directly when sent from the Army).

<u>We reached Aqua Creek safely in</u> the line <u>anticipated, and to my great joy</u> learned immediately that our old friend <u><u>Capt (Maj) Hood</u></u> (of the 21<sup>st</sup>) was B. Master as soon as the Boat was unloaded he came on board and spent the remainder of the evening with me. - we had a <u>home chat</u> I assure you - remained till the next day, sent a lot of apples <u>etc</u> up to the Capt's quarters, and <u>proceeded</u> with the remainders of our luggage for which it is needless to say ready transported
